jobs.title: Office Manager - Part Time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Office Manager (Part-Time)

Leeds – Morley | 3 Days Per Week (Office-Based) | £36,000 FTE


About the Opportunity

Our client is a successful and growing technology business based in the heart of Leeds. With a strong reputation in its sector and an ambitious growth strategy, they are seeking a highly organised and proactive Office Operations Manager to play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the business.


This is a varied and rewarding position that combines office management, finance administration, HR support, supplier management and compliance responsibilities . Working closely with the leadership team, you will become a central figure in ensuring operational efficiency across the organisation.


The Role

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing structure, improving processes and taking ownership of business administration. You'll be responsible for keeping essential operational functions running smoothly while supporting colleagues across multiple departments.


Key Responsibilities


Office & Facilities Management

  • Oversee office suppliers, facilities and workplace services
  • Coordinate maintenance, repairs and office improvements
  • Manage office equipment and supplies
  • Liaise with landlords, contractors and service providers
  • Organise team events and employee engagement activities
  • Ensure a professional, productive and well-maintained office environment
  • Maintain Health & Safety records and documentation
  • Coordinate workplace compliance requirements
  • Manage Right to Work records and documentation
  • Ensure company records remain accurate and up to date
  • Handle confidential employee and business information appropriately


Finance & Business Administration

  • Process supplier invoices and maintain accurate financial records
  • Support purchase and sales ledger activities
  • Manage employee expense processing
  • Assist with payroll administration
  • Maintain supplier and customer databases
  • Support month-end financial processes and reporting
  • Manage contract and renewal schedules
  • Produce operational and cost reports for management


Supplier & Cost Management

  • Monitor company overheads and operational expenditure
  • Manage software subscriptions, licences and supplier contracts
  • Track contract renewals and key supplier relationships
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and efficiencies
  • Obtain quotations and support supplier negotiations
  • Ensure supplier invoices align with agreed terms
  • Assist with budget monitoring and expenditure controls


HR Administration

  • Maintain employee records and HR documentation
  • Coordinate recruitment administration and interview scheduling
  • Support onboarding and offboarding processes
  • Monitor absence, holiday and sickness records
  • Coordinate probation reviews and appraisal processes
  • Maintain HR policies and employee handbook documentation
  • Support employee relations and performance management administration
  • Ensure HR compliance with current employment legislation


Essential Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in working as an office manager
  • Strong finance administration, bookkeeping or accounting support experience
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills
  • Knowledge of Xero or similar accounting software
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Experience managing suppliers, contracts and operational budgets
  • Strong IT skills, including spreadsheets and business systems
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to take ownership and work proactively


What's on Offer?

  • Flexible part-time working arrangement
  • Broad and varied role with genuine responsibility
  • Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership
  • Friendly, collaborative and supportive culture
  • Chance to make a tangible impact within a growing business
  • Central Leeds location with excellent transport links


If you're someone who thrives on organisation, enjoys improving processes and wants to make a meaningful contribution to a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.


Due to the amount of response we receive, unfortunately we are not able to give feedback to individuals, if you have not heard back within 5 days please assume that you have not been successful for the role you have applied for. By applying to this advertisement, you are hereby giving consent for Jo Holdsworth Recruitment to hold your details for a 30 day period and contact you via any method of contact you have listed on your application.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Key Stage One Teacher - Part-Time & Full-Time Opportunities
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you an experienced Key Stage One teacher looking for your next role in a supportive, well-run primary school? Whether you’re after flexible part-time work or a longer-term full-time position, I’d genuinely like to hear from you.

I work closely with a large and growing number of primary schools across the Wakefield area, supporting them with high-quality teaching staff. Over time, these relationships have been built on trust, reliability, and consistency - and because of the reputation Reed has gained locally, more schools are choosing to work with us, meaning more great opportunities for teachers.

This is not a one-size-fits-all agency advert. I take the time to get to know the teachers I work with, understand what kind of school environment suits you best, and match you accordingly.

What’s on offer
  • A range of Key Stage One roles (Year 1 & Year 2)
  • Part-time, full-time, short-term and long-term bookings
  • Opportunities in welcoming, well-led primary schools
  • Roles suited to teachers seeking flexibility, work–life balance, or stability
  • Competitive daily rates, paid weekly through Reed
What I’m looking for
  • Qualified Teacher Status (QTS)
  • Experience teaching in Key Stage One
  • Strong classroom practice with a nurturing approach
  • Confident behaviour management and good curriculum knowledge
  • A positive, professional attitude and a genuine passion for primary teaching
Why work with me through Reed?
  • I support many primary schools throughout Wakefield, so you won’t be limited to one setting
  • You’ll have honest conversations about roles - no pressure, no false promises
  • I’ll only put you forward for schools I believe are a good fit for you
  • Reed is an established name in education, and locally schools trust us

If you’re a KS1 teacher who wants to feel valued, supported, and matched with schools where you can really make a difference, I’d love to speak with you.

Apply today or get in touch for a confidential conversation about the roles currently available.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Self-Employed Conractor (Remote, full or part time)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sales Development Representative — Self-Employed Contractor (Remote or Hybrid, Full or Part Time)


At FISCAL Technologies, we're not just selling software — we're partnering with finance leaders to protect over £350 billion of global spend every year through innovative AI-driven solutions that deliver ROI within three months.


We're looking for a passionate relationship builder who can open doors, book meetings and help develop sales opportunities — and who wants the flexibility and independence of working as a self-employed contractor rather than as a PAYE employee.


Important — please read before applying


This is a self-employed consultancy engagement, not an employed role. You'll invoice us on an agreed day rate, be responsible for your own tax and National Insurance (or local equivalent), and carry your own professional indemnity insurance. If you're looking for a salary, holiday pay, pension contributions or other employee benefits, this engagement isn't the right fit.


We have a strong preference for candidates based in the UK, US or Canada. For data security and information governance reasons, applications from candidates based and authorised to work in one of these three countries will be prioritised.


Successful candidates will be required to complete a basic background/security check, carried out in their country of residence, before being granted access to our internal systems. This is in line with our information security and data protection commitments to our customers.


The role


Working directly with our new business sales and marketing teams, your focus will be booking qualified new business meetings:


• Prospecting and lead generation — identifying and researching organisations that fit our ideal customer profile

• Outbound outreach — initiating contact through phone, email and social channels

• Lead qualification — assessing interest, budget and need against agreed criteria

• Booking meetings — scheduling qualified meetings and demonstrations for Account Executives

• Reporting and tracking outcomes

• Collaboration — working closely with sales and marketing colleagues on strategy and messaging


Required skills and experience


• Excellent verbal, written and listening communication

• Strong organisation and time management — comfortable managing a high volume of activity

• Proficiency with CRM systems and modern sales tools

• Persistence, self-motivation and the discipline that goes with self-employed working

• Prior SDR, BDR or outbound prospecting experience preferred


Commercial terms

• Day rate and weekly commitment to be agreed — we have flexibility on both

• Monthly invoicing, paid within 14 days of approved invoice

• Initial probation period with a short notice period, continuing by agreement thereafter

• Remote or hybrid (occasional visits to the office in Reading are possible with time and travel costs reimbursed)


Why FISCAL?


• Be part of an exciting growth company protecting organisations around the world

• Our solutions deliver meaningful impact for finance teams worldwide

• Flexibility and independence as a self-employed partner, not an employee

• Work alongside experienced sales and marketing colleagues backed by strong product-market fit


FISCAL Technologies is a previous recipient of the Queen's Award for Enterprise (Innovation) and is recognised as a great place to work. We're committed to working with a diverse network of contractors and partners that reflects the clients we serve.


To apply, please send a short message outlining your relevant experience, your location, and your indicative day rate and weekly availability.
